CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.

2. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   B. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Netball.

3. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. Only the volume
   C. The ticket price
   D. The speed of the music

4. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   D. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

6. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.

7. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

8. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Songs.

9. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

10. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   C. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   D. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   C. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.

12. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

13. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games.

14. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.
   B. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.
   D. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

15. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Photography.
   B. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Photography.
   D. Damage equipment used for Photography.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Percussion Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Netball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Montage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Gymnastics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
